{{Quote|Is there anything in the cosmos more beautiful than the purple night sky of Talay?|Kyle Katarn|<ref name="Dark Forces Official Player's Guide">''[[Dark Forces Official Player's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''Talay''' was a oceanic [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
===Great Galactic War===
At some point, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost and communication hub existed on Talay during the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Military]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Broysc]] commanded the Imperial forces during the [[Battle of Talay]] only to watch the battle conclude in a Republic victory.<ref>{{TORcite|type=conversation|Malavai Quinn|Incompetent}}</ref> [[Standard decade/Legends|Decades]] after their defeat, the Empire would again attempt to conquer Talay, as it remained the site of a major Republic outpost and communication hub, when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Arkous]] masterminded the [[invasion of Talay]].<ref name="Arkous">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20140731|text=Lana Beniko's Journal: Darth Arkous}}</ref>

Before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Republic demolitions expert [[Tanno Vik]] masterminded a protection racket while stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He was subsequently discharged from military service.

At the beginning of the [[Galactic War]], there had also been an incident regarding a corrupt army officer who had been selling weapons on the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Seller's Market}}</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
[[File:BattleOfTalay1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The attack]]
The planet hosted the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Tak Base]], commanded by Admiral [[Toka]]. Several months after the [[Evacuation of Yavin]], the planet was [[Attack on Tak Base|invaded]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] new [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]]. Only the ''[[Grey Damsel]]'' escaped the planet, but the crew did not realize a dark trooper was onboard. The dark trooper killed the entire crew, and the ship crashed on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Tak Base was taken over by the Empire. [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Mission to Talay|infiltrated]] the base and escaped with a prototype weapon for the [[Dark Trooper Project]], which would then lead him to [[Anoat/Legends|Anoat]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Talaylandscape.jpg|thumb|Mountains of Talay under the purple night sky]]
Talay first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Dark Forces]]''. In a cutscene, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] referred to it as the "City of Talay", which indicates that "Talay" might have meant to be the name of the city. The ''Dark Forces'' script, also mentions the "home planet of the city of Talay".

Later official sources identified "Talay" as the name of the planet.
